Free AI course 4 of 5: IBM SkillsBuild 🎬

Your movie app seems to know your taste. Your chatbot understands “something funny, under 2 hours.” Curious about the AI ideas behind experiences like these?

Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals from IBM SkillsBuild covers machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, language processing, computer vision, AI ethics and applications.

The learning and digital credential are free. To earn the credential, you must complete the required courses, pass graded quizzes and final assessments, and complete practice simulations. A registered SkillsBuild account is required. IBM lists the credential as intermediate level, so basic familiarity with AI terms is useful.

My study approach: after each lesson, close your notes and explain one concept to a friend. Then pick an everyday example: what goes in, what comes out, and what could go wrong?

The movie-night example in this carousel is our illustration—not an IBM course assignment.

Start here (official IBM credential page, with enrollment links):
https://www.credly.com/org/ibm-skillsbuild/badge/artificial-intelligence-fundamentals

Save this for your next study session. Which would you rather understand: how AI recommends movies or how it recognizes images?
